Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made an error in determining the number of years it took for the percentage of women in computer science to decrease by 13%. Although the historical data was correctly sourced as changing from 37% in 1995 to 24% in 2017, the agent mistakenly assumed the "today" cited in the evidence as being 2025, rather than using the actual year of the report (which is 2017). This resulted in an incorrect calculation of the time span as 30 years (2025 - 1995) instead of the correct 22 years (2017 - 1995). This error aligns with an overreliance on incomplete or misinterpreted information from the search results without sufficiently verifying the sources or clarifying ambiguous temporal references.
